clinician.trajectory_summary: A 60-year-old man with HIV presented with altered mental status, bilateral cervical and left inguinal lymphadenopathy, and diffuse rhonchi. Initial workup revealed pancytopenia, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury, lactic acidosis, an unremarkable CT head, and a chest X-ray showing airspace opacity. A lumbar puncture showed lymphocytic pleocytosis and elevated protein in CSF, with negative infectious workup. Lymph node sampling revealed histopathology with fibrinoid necrosis and atypical lymphocytes. Immunophenotyping showed EBV-EBER-positive, CD30-positive, and Cd15 rarely positive cells, along with positivity for LCA, BOB-1, ALK, CD79a, bcl-2, CD3, OCT 2, CD20, PAX-5, and CD68. These findings are consistent with Lymphomatoid Granulomatosis (LyG), particularly Grade III given the atypical lymphocytes and EBV association.

key_supporting_evidence.claim: Patient presented with altered mental status, bilateral cervical and left inguinal lymphadenopathy, and diffuse rhonchi.
Initial laboratory tests revealed pancytopenia, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, acute kidney injury, with lactic acidosis.
Chest X-ray showed airspace opacity of the lateral right lung base, concerning for pneumonia.
Lumbar puncture revealed lymphocytic pleocytosis (lymphocytes 30) and elevated protein (66.3) in CSF, with negative infectious workup for common pathogens.
Histopathology staining after lymph node sampling showed fibrinoid necrosis and atypical lymphocytes in the background.
Lymph node aspiration revealed EBV-EBER-positive, CD30-positive, and Cd15 rarely positive cells.
Immunophenotyping showed positivity for LCA, BOB-1, ALK, CD79a, bcl-2, CD3, OCT 2, CD20, PAX-5, and CD68 in the aspiration sample.
